plan.title: Toggle RFP Questionnaire Form and Table Views

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create flow needed to configure an RFP technical stage.
Every successful create flow requires an event title.
Configure the event as an RFP so the questionnaire view is available.
Work on the technical stage where Basic Details questions are displayed.
Apply the available RFP template containing the Basic Details question.
Open and prepare the technical questionnaire so its Basic Details questions are rendered.
Confirm the target questionnaire section is present before changing views.
Switch the questionnaire from Form View to Table View.
Check that the Question column is shown in the table.
Check that the Description column is shown in the table.
Check that the Vendor Response column is shown in the table.
Switch the questionnaire back to Form View.
Confirm the questionnaire is back on the Form View control/state.
Confirm the Basic Details questionnaire remains displayed after returning to Form View.
